candidate.title: External Java bytecode library inside the agent
candidate.rejectionReason: The pinned runtime ships java.lang.classfile, so an external rewriting library would add a shaded Java dependency to every launch for an API the runtime already provides. Ravel also ships no Java artifacts it does not have to, and a shaded library is exactly such an artifact.
